caption: The drawing contains a central figure seated on a brown-accented chair, wearing a teal blue robe with maroon and black vertical stripes and a maroon cape. The figure has a white face with black hair and a black feathered hat, and is depicted holding a basket with their left hand and a staff with two gourds attached in their right hand. The background features a cream-colored wall and a deep blue triangular drapery at the top. To either side of the figure are two silver-colored vases, each holding red, pink, and orange flowers with green leaves. Beneath the scene is the text "EL SANTO NINO DE ATOCHA" written in all capital black letters. The entire scene is framed by a thin black rectangular border, and the background surrounding the central design is a muted beige color.
title: Plate 24: The Lost Child of Atocha: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
